title: Mach Natural Resources LP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Mach Natural Resources LP filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026 disclosing a secondary offering of 9,000,000 common units (trading symbol MNR on NYSE) sold by selling unitholders through Morgan Stanley as underwriter. The offering closed on April 8, 2026. The company did not receive any proceeds from the sale.
key_points: Mach Natural Resources LP sold 9,000,000 common units (MNR) via secondary offering; selling unitholders granted underwriter 30-day option for up to 1,350,000 additional units
Underwriting agreement dated April 6, 2026 between the company, its general partner, selling unitholders, and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC
Company received no proceeds from the offering; all proceeds went to selling unitholders
CEO Tom L. Ward purchased 153,256 common units in the offering through affiliated entities
Offering pursuant to Form S-3 registration statement (File No. 333-291166), effective December 12, 2025
Kirkland & Ellis LLP provided legal opinions regarding the offering
